living_world.name: Living World Core
living_world.description: Hash-chained JSONL event ledger + world engine with action executor
features: SHA-256 hash-chained event ledger (GENESIS → chain)
Append-only JSONL storage with tamper detection
Fork detection and non-destructive branch reconstruction
World engine: observe, examine, move, speak, wait, write
UNSUPPORTED actions (shell, exec, python, subprocess, os.system, eval) rejected
target_state semantics: 0=absent, 1=remote, 2=local/visible
GroundedMemory with causal provenance chain
Observation states: KNOWN, INFERRED, UNKNOWN, UNOBSERVABLE, TESTABLE
behavioral_fingerprint() invariant under seed-only changes
No protagonist privilege — all actors validated equally

validation_engine.name: Validation Engine
validation_engine.description: Trillion-scale scenario space validation with affine sampling
features: 16-dimension ScenarioBlueprint (2,853,804,441,600 logical scenarios)
PERMUTATION_STEP = 1,000,003 (coprime to scenario space)
Affine sampling: smoke=1K, standard=10K, deep=100K, stress=1M cap
10 invariant checks: action safety, causal chain, perception privacy, etc.
Scenario shrinking: reduce failing scenario to minimal case
ValidationReport with SHA-256 digest and accounting invariants
Regression corpus support
Never reports more tests than actually executed

trading_world.name: Trading World
features: SimulatedExchange: market/limit orders, partial fills, slippage, fees
Order book with price-time priority, adverse selection modeling
Liquidity limits — no unrealistic fills through unavailable liquidity
6 agent families: MarketMaker, Momentum, MeanReversion, Volatility, Noise, Adversarial
10,000 heterogeneous agents via efficient cohort representation
AgentMemory: episodic, summary, graph, rare/decisive
Agent genealogy: parentage, mutation lineage, descendants
14-model council: OrderBook, OrderFlow, Momentum, MeanReversion, Volatility, Regime, CrossMarket, Technical, Execution, Risk, News, Calibration, Critic, Meta
Multi-horizon prediction: tick → seconds → 1-5min → 5-15min → 15-30min → session
ABSTAIN / NO TRADE is a valid prediction outcome
Predictions committed BEFORE outcomes observed (immutable)
CounterfactualSimulator: divergent continuations from same state
PredictionErrorMemory: prediction, outcome, votes, disagreement, failure causes
Belief states: KNOWN, INFERRED, UNKNOWN, UNOBSERVABLE, TESTABLE
9 market regimes: bull, bear, high vol, low vol, crash, recovery, sideways, high-rate, low-rate
Multi-objective: edge - costs - slippage - adverse_selection - drawdown - tail_risk - uncertainty - complexity - instability
Metrics: win_rate, wilson_lower_bound, expectancy, profit_factor, sharpe, sortino, max_drawdown, calibration, brier_score, abstention_quality
Refuses real_money=True — no live brokerage execution
